_about: AgenticCore city and area gazetteer: the single source for the websites (ac-cities.js, generated) and the bots (services/places.mjs). Area names follow how Zameen.com groups locations; 'shared' lists societies that sit across a city line (Zameen files DHA Defence phases under Islamabad and Bahria Town phases under Rawalpindi). Edit here, then run: node scripts/gen-cities.mjs
